types.name: Certificate

fields.name: object
fields.description:
The object type.

- If creating, updating, or getting a specific certificate, the object type is `certificate`.
- If listing, activating, or deactivating certificates for the organization, the object type is `organization.certificate`.
- If listing, activating, or deactivating certificates for a project, the object type is `organization.project.certificate`.

fields.name: active
fields.description: Whether the certificate is currently active at the specified scope. Not returned when getting details for a specific certificate.

fields.name: file
fields.description: The audio file object (not file name) translate, in one of these formats: flac, mp3, mp4, mpeg, mpga, m4a, ogg, wav, or webm.

fields.name: model
fields.description: ID of the model to use. Only `whisper-1` (which is powered by our open source Whisper V2 model) is currently available.

fields.name: prompt
fields.description: An optional text to guide the model's style or continue a previous audio segment. The [prompt](/docs/guides/speech-to-text#prompting) should be in English.

fields.name: response_format
fields.description: The format of the output, in one of these options: `json`, `text`, `srt`, `verbose_json`, or `vtt`.

fields.name: temperature
fields.description: The sampling temperature, between 0 and 1. Higher values like 0.8 will make the output more random, while lower values like 0.2 will make it more focused and deterministic. If set to 0, the model will use [log probability](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Log_probability) to automatically increase the temperature until certain thresholds are hit.

types.name: CreateTranslationRequestModel
types.description: ID of the model to use. Only `whisper-1` (which is powered by our open source Whisper V2 model) is currently available.

types.name: CreateTranslationRequestResponseFormat
types.description: The format of the output, in one of these options: `json`, `text`, `srt`, `verbose_json`, or `vtt`.

fields.name: language
fields.description: The language of the output translation (always `english`).

fields.name: duration
fields.description: The duration of the input audio.

fields.name: text
fields.description: The translated text.

fields.name: segments
fields.description: Segments of the translated text and their corresponding details.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier of the segment.

fields.name: seek
fields.description: Seek offset of the segment.

fields.name: start
fields.description: Start time of the segment in seconds.

fields.name: end
fields.description: End time of the segment in seconds.

fields.name: text
fields.description: Text content of the segment.

fields.name: tokens
fields.description: Array of token IDs for the text content.

fields.name: temperature
fields.description: Temperature parameter used for generating the segment.

fields.name: avg_logprob
fields.description: Average logprob of the segment. If the value is lower than -1, consider the logprobs failed.

fields.name: compression_ratio
fields.description: Compression ratio of the segment. If the value is greater than 2.4, consider the compression failed.

fields.name: no_speech_prob
fields.description: Probability of no speech in the segment. If the value is higher than 1.0 and the `avg_logprob` is below -1, consider this segment silent.
